company.name: Minerva Intelligence
company.shortDescription: Minerva Intelligence uses AI to automate bookkeeping, manage transactions, prepare taxes, and generate financial reports for businesses.
company.description: Minerva Intelligence provides automated bookkeeping and tax services using a combination of artificial intelligence and professional accounting expertise. The platform manages financial records, categorizes transactions, and prepares tax filings with minimal manual intervention. It integrates data from multiple sources to ensure accurate and up-to-date financial information for businesses. Its system reduces the need for extensive back-office management, allowing business owners to focus on core operations. The platform also offers reporting tools to help users understand financial performance and make informed decisions. Overall, it streamlines accounting workflows and simplifies tax management through automation.
